title: Methods for Reducing Cogging Force in Permanent Magnet Machines: A Review
author: Wenjuan Hao; Gong Zhang; Wenbo Liu; Hui Liu; Yu Wang
locator: Abstract and review of cogging-force origins and design-side reduction methods in permanent-magnet machines
license_or_permission: Article published under CC BY; repository stores metadata/link only, not a copy
notes: Review of slot-effect and end-effect cogging force in permanent-magnet machines. The discussion supports conceptual categorization and design-side mitigation, not quantitative limits for a specific CNC torque motor or rotary axis.
